source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseCacheExceptionTailDeterministicTest { @isTest static void cacheExceptionAndContainerContracts() { Cache.BulkApiKeysLimitExceededException bulkIssue = new Cache.BulkApiKeysLimitExceededException('bulk'); Cache.CacheBuilderExecutionException builder = new Cache.CacheBuilderExecutionException('builder'); Cache.CacheException cacheIssue = new Cache.CacheException('cache'); Cache.ExecutionException execution = new Cache.ExecutionException('execution'); Cache.InvalidCacheBuilderException invalidBuilder = new Cache.InvalidCacheBuilderException('invalid builder'); Cache.InvalidParamException invalidParam = new Cache.InvalidParamException('invalid param'); Cache.ItemSizeLimitExceededException itemSize = new Cache.ItemSizeLimitExceededException('item size'); Cache.PlatformCacheInvalidOperationException invalidOperation = new Cache.PlatformCacheInvalidOperationException('invalid operation'); System.assertNotEquals(null, bulkIssue.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, builder.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, cacheIssue.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, execution.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, invalidBuilder.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, invalidParam.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, itemSize.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, invalidOperation.clone()); Object orgTtl = Cache.Org.MAX_TTL_SECS; Cache.OrgPartition orgPartition = new Cache.OrgPartition('local.default'); System.assertNotEquals(null, orgPartition); Cache.Partition partition = new Cache.Partition(); System.assertNotEquals(null, partition); partition.put('ttl', 'value', 300); partition.put('full', 'value', 300, Cache.Visibility.ALL, false); Cache.PlatformCacheDelegateWrapper delegate = new Cache.PlatformCacheDelegateWrapper(); System.assertNotEquals(null, delegate); System.assertNotEquals(null, delegate.clone()); Cache.ScanResult scan = new Cache.ScanResult(new Map<String,Object>(), 'locator', false); System.assertNotEquals(null, scan); Cache.SecondaryKeyApi secondary = new Cache.SecondaryKeyApi(); System.assertNotEquals(null, secondary); Object sessionTtl = Cache.Session.MAX_TTL_SECS; System.assertNotEquals(null, orgTtl); System.assertNotEquals(null, sessionTtl); } }
